titolo: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn't make it
descr: Relay, Character.ai, OpenAI's Atlas and Operator, and Humane AI Pin are among recent AI products that have been discontinued or sold.
paragrafi: Relay, an AI workflow automation tool meant to compete with Zapier, closed in August after five years, citing competition from larger platforms that added similar features.
Chatbot platform Character.ai filed for bankruptcy five years after its launch, joining a list of AI bets that fail to survive beyond early growth.
OpenAI discontinued several stand‑alone tools, including ChatGPT Atlas, a web browser, and Operator, an AI agent, folding their capabilities into the main ChatGPT product.
Humane’s AI Pin, a wearable AI device, shut down in February 2025 after performance issues and a battery‑fire warning, with assets later sold to HP for $116 million.
Industry data shows about 42 % of corporate AI initiatives are abandoned, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence.
perche: These closures highlight the difficulty of sustaining niche AI products when larger ecosystems integrate similar features. Users may see fewer independent tools but benefit from consolidated functionality, while developers of free or local models must consider market pressure from big platforms that absorb specialized capabilities.
